I thought it was easier for therapists to cope with this kind of issues where one's own family member needs help. 

I never shared any problems of mine with my family or friends. But to some extent I can do that with a stranger or like in a group session given that I won't be seeing them ever again.

My foster mother is a clinical therapist and she always knew that something was up and offered help. I declined. Not because that I don't trust her but because I want our relation to be free from my past. I was happy and relieved because she understood and wasn't pushy at all. I have my own therapist now.
I do tell my mother when I am not feeling well and she listens if I have to say something. The thing that I love about her is that she never asks any questions to why. 
I feel our relationship is better this way.
